paragraphs.source_en: *‘‘I just don’t like you.’’* It is inevitable that we will encounter customers we do not get along with or with whom we have no connection. If, for example, you are a fast-paced and decisive individual, you might have trouble dealing with a customer who likes to take things slow and mull over decisions. In this instance, you will inevitably clash with the customer. When this happens, it is easy for the customer to get wrapped up in the personality conflict while disregarding your product or service.
